subject: Priority: throughput degradation & proposed remediation/credit
messages:
From: Caroline Diaz <cdiaz@optima.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Optima AI Support <ops@optima.ai>
Date: 2027-09-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production degradation - urgent: throughput drop + 500 errors

Sofia —

We started seeing a significant production regression in our Redwood-powered inference path this morning at ~08:45 PT. Key impact metrics over the last 90 minutes:
- Throughput down ~30% (median requests/sec) versus baseline
- 5xx error rate spiked to ~6% (previously <0.2%)
- Median tail latency (p95) jumped from 210ms to ~1.1s

This is affecting our web product (search caching and ranking) for roughly 12k active users. Ops have already shifted traffic away from a small percentage of customers to reduce impact but the error profile looks systemic.

We need executive attention. Please share: 1) an incident timeline and root-cause hypothesis, 2) proposed service credit and contract remediation, and 3) an exec call window today if possible. Attached screenshots of Grafana panels and a short logs excerpt.

Caroline
Caroline Diaz
Head of Engineering, Optima AI
caroline.diaz@optima.ai

Attachments: incident_slo_graphs.png (PNG), logs_excerpt.txt (text)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Diaz <cdiaz@optima.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production degradation - urgent: throughput drop + 500 errors

Thanks for the heads up, Caroline — I'm escalating immediately and sorry for the disruption. I understand the severity; we've flagged this as a priority incident.

Jonas (runtime lead) and Marissa (Customer Success) — I'm looping you both in to get a verified timeline and mitigation steps. Can we: 1) confirm whether this was a routing/autoscaler regression or a model-serving kernel fault, 2) provide an ETA for a hotfix, and 3) draft an interim credit proposal we can share with Optima this afternoon?

I'll coordinate an exec call if Optima wants one — please propose 30–45 minute windows.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-16T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: internal: initial incident analysis & proto credit calc

Sofia / team — quick notes from the runtime side after initial investigation:
- Root cause: a config rollout to the smart-router service incorrectly relaxed the affinity rule for a subset of Optima traffic, which allowed requests to land on a lower-capacity node pool during burst windows. This led to sustained queueing and downstream 5xx when KV cache misses amplified per-token CPU.
- Fix status: rollback of the rollout completed at 10:50 PT; observed recovery in tail latency by 11:05 PT, error rate falling back toward baseline by 11:20 PT.
- Window of impact: ~08:45 — 10:50 PT (~2h5m) with peak impact concentrated in the first 70 minutes.

Credit/proposal (proto) — using contractual SLOs (99.0% availability by month) and our credit table:
- Calculated pro-rata service credit for September (2.1 hours of breach across nominal billing period) — preliminary = 15% of monthly recurring fee (MRF) for the impacted service, rounded.
- One-time goodwill: suggest adding a $25,000 one-time credit to compensate for business ops costs + expedited remediation support.

I attached a working spreadsheet (credit_calc_sep2027.xlsx) with the math. We should run this by Vivek for commercial sign-off before sending to Optima.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Diaz <cdiaz@optima.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-17T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed remediation, credit calculation, and next steps

Caroline — thank you for your patience while we completed a technical and commercial readout. Summary below and attached supporting materials.

1) Root cause & mitigation- Short summary: misrouted traffic due to a smart-router config rollout caused a portion of requests to hit a node pool with degraded batching behavior and reduced KV cache locality.- Mitigation already executed: full rollback of the rollout at 10:50 PT on 9/16; hotfix rolled to tighten affinity rules and add a safety check to the router configuration.- Longer-term mitigation: we'll add an automated canary gating step for router config rollouts and increase telemetry around per-pool queue depth so we detect this pattern within 5 minutes.

2) Proposed commercial remediation- Technical service credit: pro-rata application for the impacted hours; preliminary calculation per our SLA yields a 15% credit against the September invoice for the affected service. See attached "credit_calc_sep2027.xlsx" for the line-by-line math.- Goodwill: a one-time $25,000 credit to cover operational disruption and partner support for mitigation.- Contract amendment: we can fast-track a short amendment clarifying the SLO attribution for multi-pool deployments if you'd like — draft attached (proposed_amendment_v1.docx).

3) Next steps and exec call- If this meets your needs we'd like to: a) confirm the credit amount and amendment edits, b) schedule a 30-minute exec call (VP-level + Optima Eng lead) to sign off, and c) execute DocuSign for the amendment and credit issuance.

Suggested call windows (PT): 9/17 14:00–15:00, 9/18 09:00–10:00, 9/18 15:30–16:30. Please tell us which works for you and who from Optima should attend.

I appreciate the frank feedback — we'll prioritize preventing recurrence.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Caroline Diaz <cdiaz@optima.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Lee <michael.lee@optima.ai>, Optima AI Support <ops@optima.ai>
Date: 2027-09-17T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed remediation, credit calculation, and next steps

Sofia — thank you for the rapid turnaround and the write-up. A few requests/points from Ops and Finance here:
1) The preliminary 15% technical credit + $25k goodwill is a good start but does not cover the measured revenue impact from our downstream partners. We need a formal statement on how you computed the 15% (line-by-line) and a proposal for an upper-bound credit if the post-incident RCA uncovers additional extended degradation.
2) Our legal/finance team require an executable amendment that explicitly references the impacted service and the time windows; can we get a version that includes the precise timestamps and the HubSpot deal id?
3) Exec call: we want VP-level attendees from both sides. Proposed attendees: Caroline Diaz (me), Michael Lee (CFO), Optima Eng lead (TBD), and Redwood: Sofia, Vivek, and an engineering lead. 9/18 15:30 PT works for us.

Please send the detailed calculation and updated amendment before the call so Finance can review.

-Caroline
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Diaz <cdiaz@optima.ai>, Michael Lee <michael.lee@optima.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-18T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed remediation, credit calculation, and next steps — confirmed exec call and pre-read

Caroline / Michael — thank you. Call confirmed for 9/18 at 15:30 PT. Attendees from Redwood: Vivek Kulkarni (VP, Product), Jonas Weber (Principal Infra Engineer), Marissa Cole (Customer Success), and myself.

Attached I've included: 1) the detailed credit calculation workbook (credit_calc_sep2027.xlsx) with line-by-line SLO math and sensitivity scenarios, 2) an updated amendment that includes exact timestamps and HubSpot deal id (proposed_amendment_v1.docx), and 3) incident graphs (incident_slo_graphs.png).

Action items before the call:
- Redwood (Jonas): ensure the calculation workbook includes an upper-bound sensitivity that covers extended tail impact if the RCA finds additional hours.
- Redwood (Vivek): commercial sign-off on the 15% + $25k proposal, and authority to expand if execs agree on exposure.
- Optima (Michael/Finance): review the amendment and calculations and send any edits via DocuSign link by 9/18 12:00 PT if possible.

DocuSign (pre-draft): https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABCD1234
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/companies/OPT-987
Drive pre-read: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1abcXYZ

We'll be prepared with a short technical timeline and proposed mitigations on the call. Appreciate the partnership here — our objective is to make this right and prevent recurrence.

—Sofia
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
